description: A live TV guide for any M3U playlist; plays on the card's screen or on a TV over HDMI

store.summary: Your channels on the card and on the big screen.
store.description: A tiny, fast TV guide. Point it at any M3U playlist - your Jellyfin or Plex, your IPTV provider, an iptv-org list, or a file of URLs you wrote yourself - browse it by group or type any letter to search, press ENTER and it plays. On the Cardputer's own 320x170 screen, or fullscreen on a TV the moment an HDMI cable is plugged in, and it follows the cable live. Hardware-decoded by the card's VideoCore, so the CPU barely moves, and it picks the smallest rendition for the little screen and the biggest for the TV. Ships with 27 free live channels built in - news, world, sport and classic TV, straight from the broadcasters' own CDNs - so it works the moment you install it, with no account and no config file. A static Rust binary, two crates, instant start.
